annotations.text:
Nexthop — an internet quality monitor for Omarchy.

Splits your Wi-Fi from your ISP, hop by hop.

Everything here is lifted from the real shell source: JetBrains Mono, square corners (your Hyprland rounding is 0), 2px #7aa2f7 panel border, and the 10px uppercase-dim label over bright-value grammar that the built-in network panel and Vitals both use.

Static mockups, one artboard per screen.

Five tabs, one panel.

Overview answers "is it me or is it them" in one glance. The other four are for when the answer is them.

The Overview artboard has a state switch above it — flip it to degraded or outage to see the bad days, including the recommendation strip.

The plugin stays a thin reader. nexthopd — Python 3, standard library only — owns every measurement and writes three files.

Settled: Python over Rust, because it installs with just a clone. A prebuilt binary in the repo would trip the marketplace's automated security baseline.
